Next Gen Talent
Company: ASSISTIVE TECH SUPPLIERS PTY LTD
Position: Software Engineer
Location: 1/16 First Avenue, Broadbeach QLD, 4218 Australia
Salary: $120K to 130K + Super.

Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree or higher qualification with at least 3 years of experience as a Software Engineer.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
Analyse business processes, workflows, and operational challenges to identify opportunities where Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) can deliver measurable business value and improve efficiency.
Manage cloud hosting infrastructure, application servers, development environments, and deployment platforms to ensure secure, reliable, and high-performing AI applications.
Design, develop, and deploy production-grade AI solutions using modern AI architectures, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), autonomous AI agents, vector databases, semantic search, and agent-to-agent communication frameworks.
Develop, deploy, and maintain Machine Learning models following MLOps best practices, including model lifecycle management, automated CI/CD pipelines, model versioning, performance monitoring, drift detection, retraining, and governance.
Build and integrate AI-powered applications using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, and other enterprise AI platforms alongside custom software development.
Conduct proof-of-concept (PoC) projects and prototype AI solutions within sandbox environments to evaluate emerging technologies, compare implementation approaches, and validate business outcomes.
Contribute to software solution architecture by designing scalable, secure, cloud-native AI systems that integrate with existing enterprise applications and data platforms.
Present technical findings, solution options, feasibility assessments, and strategic recommendations to senior management, project stakeholders, and both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ensure AI solutions comply with Responsible AI principles by implementing appropriate guardrails, explainability, transparency, human-in-the-loop decision processes, security controls, privacy requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.
Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable web, cloud, and enterprise applications integrating AI/ML capabilities using modern software engineering practices.
Develop RESTful APIs, microservices, and secure integrations connecting AI services with enterprise applications, databases, and third-party platforms.
Optimise AI model performance, application scalability, cloud infrastructure utilisation, and operational reliability through continuous monitoring and performance tuning.
Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, architectural diagrams, deployment procedures, and operational guides to support ongoing maintenance and knowledge sharing.

Skills & Attributes:
Good knowledge on software configuration management systems
Logical thinking and problem-solving skills along with an ability to collaborate.
Proficiency in troubleshooting software issues and debugging a large codebase.
Experience writing functional and technical documentation.
Act as a source of knowledge on best practice in the implementation of operational software systems.

How to Apply:
To apply for this role, please send your resume to info@nextgentalent.com.au. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted. All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality.

With a strong pipeline of upcoming projects and continued business growth, they are seeking an experienced Senior Contracts Administrator to join their Brisbane team. 
 This is an excellent opportunity to work on large-scale luxury apartment developments valued between $170 million and $200 million, taking ownership of the commercial function from pre-contract through to project delivery. 
  Key Responsibilities:  
 
 Lead procurement, tendering, and management of subcontract packages through to final account. 
 Administer subcontract agreements, variations, progress claims, and contract correspondence. 
 Assess and manage subcontractor claims and payment schedules. 
 Monitor project costs, forecasting, budgets, and monthly financial reporting. 
 Manage head contract administration and commercial risk. 
 Maintain accurate project records and ensure contractual compliance. 
 Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, consultants, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders. 
 
  Experience Required:  
 
 Proven experience as a Senior Contracts Administrator or a highly capable Contracts Administrator ready to step into a senior position. 
 Qualifications in Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, Commercial Management, or a related discipline. 
 Experience delivering large-scale residential, commercial, or mixed-use construction projects. 
 Strong commercial acumen with excellent attention to detail. 
 Well-developed stakeholder management and communication skills. 
 Experience using construction management and project administration software. 
 Ability to thrive in a fast-paced project environment while managing competing priorities. 
 
  How to Apply  
 Click Apply or contact Hayley Wilson, Principal Consultant - Engineering & Construction, on  0407 447 248  or  hayley.wilson@randstad.com.au  for a confidential discussion. 
 If this opportunity isn't quite right, but you're interested in exploring other construction opportunities across Queensland, connect with Hayley Wilson on LinkedIn to stay informed about future opportunities. 

 At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background. 
   
    Please  click here  to apply.

Philip Riley is looking for a talented ICT Project Manager to join our team.

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

· Directing ICT project development information management system design, installation infrastructure, making

strategies, planning policies and providing training as customers required;

· Developing project scope, goals, deliverables, timeline, budget, goals which meet customers' requirement and needs;

· Developing contingency plans and project backup plans;

· Providing technical consulting including purchase, maintenance, hardware, networks, operating system, and databases;

· Assigning tasks and responsibilities, setting specific and measurable objectives, monitoring progress, reviewing outputs and

evaluating outcomes;

· Communicating with external organisations including suppliers; outsource contractors and others project relating outside services

The successful candidate would be skilled in

· Ensuring plans and approaches are achievable and are utilising resources across the program effectively.

· Applying effective leadership to deliver project success.

· Ensuring good practice project management discipline is being applied to the projects, including risk management.

· Ensuring effective communication across projects, and with supporting program functions, to manage interdependencies appropriately.

· Developing and maintaining project management artefacts

· Have a minimum of 1 year experience

Salary - $87,500 - $107,500 + Superannuation.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

result.description: Efficient Recruitment Pty Ltd  Australian Centre for Sight is looking for a skilled Systems Administrator to take full ownership of our practice's IT environment across approximately 30 devices, including workstations, computers, and specialised medical equipment. This is a hands-on infrastructure role covering device management, system administration, security, and technical support.   Benefits   Task & responsibilities   Manage, configure and maintain approximately 30 devices across the practice, including computers, workstations and specialised medical equipment  Administer user accounts, logins, and access permissions across all systems  Provide technical support and troubleshooting for medical devices, including equipment operating on legacy systems  Administer and provide ongoing technical support for the practice's medical administration software  Maintain and support the in-house billing system, including troubleshooting, configuration and liaison with the original developers/vendors as required  Manage and maintain internal communication platforms used across the practice  Implement and enforce security protocols tailored to the handling of sensitive patient and medical data  Monitor system performance across all managed devices, troubleshoot hardware/software issues, and resolve technical faults in a timely manner  Plan for and manage backups, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures across the device fleet  Liaise with external vendors and service providers for hardware, software, and medical device support  Maintain accurate documentation of system configurations, processes and procedures for all managed devices  Continually assess the current device fleet and future IT infrastructure needs, recommending upgrades or enhancements    Qualification & experience   Proven experience as a Systems Administrator managing a fleet of devices/workstations  Experience supporting or integrating legacy systems alongside modern platforms  Understanding of medical/healthcare administration software  Strong knowledge of network security, data protection, and compliance requirements (healthcare data experience highly regarded)  Experience maintaining or supporting business-critical applications (medical billing systems experience essential )  Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across hardware, software and network environments  Excellent communication skills and ability to liaise with clinical staff, administrative teams, and external vendors  Relevant tertiary qualification in Information Technology, Computer Systems, or related field   About Company    Australian Centre for Sight is a specialist ophthalmology practice providing comprehensive eye care services to our patients. We are seeking an experienced Systems Administrator to manage our IT infrastructure and support our clinical and administrative operations.
